beats.say: Captain Bavuma just smashed a majestic 179 against Australia.
According to the Guardian, the skipper played a controlled and battling innings at St George's Park.
He officially eclipsed his previous best of 172 against the West Indies in 2023.
Harmer also achieved his highest Test score during the match.
The team finished up by declaring on an enormous 425-9.
What is your all-time favourite cricket match memory?
